19B9: Ghat = body. Antari = within. Ghat ghat antari = within every body. Sarab = all. Nirantari = unbroken within. Sarab nirantari = unbroken within all. Antaru = gap. Nirantari = without gap, unbroken. Eko = one (Himself) alone.
O Hari! You are pervasive within every body; You are present unbroken within all beings; You alone are contained within all.
You are constant in each and every heart, and in all things. O Dear Lord, you are the One.
You, O venerable and unique Lord God! art uniterruptedly contained in all the hearts and every thing.
O Hari Purakh Ji! Within every body and body, (nirantari) of one flavour, You alone are contained as one.

You dwell within every heart, present in all — You alone, the One Being, pervade everywhere. Some are givers, some are beggars — all are Your wondrous play. You Yourself are the giver, You Yourself are the enjoyer — I know none other than You. You are the infinite, infinite Transcendent Lord — what can I say of Your glory? Those who serve, who serve You — servant Nanak is a sacrifice to them. ||2||
L2H2: Iki = {plural of the word 'ik'} some beings. Date = givers. Bhekhari = beggars. Sabhi = all. Vidan = wondrous. Choj = plays, shows.
(And yet) some beings are givers, some beings are beggars — all these are Your own wondrous shows,
Some are givers, and some are beggars. This is all Your Wondrous Play.
Some are the givers and some the mumpers. All these are Yours worderous frolics.
O Hari Ji! In the world, some have been made givers and some have been made beggars. All these (vidana) wondrous (choj) shows are Yours alone.
VYNS: Bhugta = the enjoyer, the user. Hau = haun, I.
(because in truth) You Yourself are the giver of gifts, and You Yourself the user (of those gifts). (In all the creation) I recognise no other apart from You (apart from You no other is to be seen).
You Yourself are the Giver, and You Yourself are the Enjoyer. I know no other than You.
You Yourself are the Giver and Yourself the Enjoyer. Beside You I know of none other.
You Yourself are the giver and You Yourself the enjoyer; I know no second apart from You.
RBRY: Akhi = having spoken. Vakhana = may I describe.
You are the boundless Parbrahm. Which of Your virtues shall I sing and tell?
You are the Supreme Lord God, Limitless and Infinite. What Virtues of Yours can I speak of and describe?
You are the infinite and limitless supreme Lord, What excellences of Yours should I narrate and recount?
O Parbrahm Ji! You are without limit within the three times; what of Your virtues shall I describe with the mouth?
J3TN: Sevahi = they remember. Janu Nanak = {look carefully at the difference between 'jan Nanak' in the previous stanza and this 'janu Nanaku'} ||2||
O Prabhu! Those men who remember You, who meditate upon You — Your servant Nanak is a sacrifice to them. ||2||
To those who serve You, to those who serve You, Dear Lord, servant Nanak is a sacrifice. ||2||
Servant Nanak is a sacrifice to those who serve, who serve You, O sire Lord!
Sri Guru Ji says: those servants of Yours who serve with the mind, I go as a sacrifice to those servants. ||2||
WA39: Hari ji = O Prabhu Ji! Dhiavahi = they remember. Se jan = those men. Jugi mahi = within life. Sukhvasi = dwelling in happiness.
O Prabhu Ji! Those men who remember You and fix their attention upon You dwell in happiness within their own lifetime.
Those who meditate on You, Lord, those who meditate on You-those humble beings dwell in peace in this world.
Who deliberate and ponder over You, O Sire Lord! those persons abide in peace in this world.
O Hari Ji! Those who meditate upon You with mind and speech, those servants dwell in happiness in (jug) the world, or in age after age — the sense being, always.

Those who meditate, meditate on You, dwell in peace through life. Liberated, liberated are those who have meditated on the Lord — the noose of death is cut for them. Those who have meditated on the fearless Lord — all their fear is dispelled. Those who have served my Lord merge into His very form. Blessed, blessed are those who have meditated on the Lord — servant Nanak is a sacrifice to them. ||3||
WXAW: Mukatu = free (from the bonds of Maya). Phasi = noose.
Those men who have remembered the Hari-Nam have become free for ever from the bonds of Maya; the noose of the jams has been cut for them (spiritual death does not come near them). ||
They are liberated, they are liberated-those who meditate on the Lord. For them, the noose of death is cut away.
Emancipated and liberated are they who remember You, O Sire God, Their death's noose is cut.

O Hari Ji! Those who have meditated upon You, they alone have become free from the world; and then they have become free even from the desire for mukti. The noose of the Jam in the form of coming and going has been cut for them.
E68A: Bhau sabhu = all fear. Gavasi = He removes.
Those men who have always remembered the Nam of the fearless Prabhu — Prabhu removes all their fear.
Those who meditate on the Fearless One, on the Fearless Lord-all their fears are dispelled.
They who meditate on the Fearless, the Fearless Lord; their fear is all shaken off.
O fearless Hari Ji! Those who, becoming fearless of the world, have meditated upon You in order to become fearless — their fear of every kind You remove and will remove.
AZ2A: Rupi = in the form. Samasi = they merge.
Those men who have always remembered the beloved Prabhu have merged into the very form of Prabhu.
Those who serve, those who serve my Dear Lord, are absorbed into the Being of the Lord, Har, Har.
They who have served, they who have served my Sire God; they are absorbed in the personality of Lord God.
O my Master Hari Ji! Those who have served You with mind and speech — they have (samai) gone into Your form as remover of sorrows.
ZPJH: Dhann = fortunate. Bali jasi = goes as a sacrifice ||3||
Fortunate are those men, blessed are those men, who have remembered Prabhu's Nam. Servant Nanak is a sacrifice to them. ||3||
Blessed are they, blessed are they, who meditate on their Dear Lord. Servant Nanak is a sacrifice to them. ||3||
Blest are they, blest are they, who have meditated on Sire God. Servant Nanak is devoted to then.
O Hari Ji! Those who have meditated upon You, those persons are blessed exceedingly. Sri Guru Ji says: I, a servant, go as a sacrifice to such servants as these. ||3||
BWH4: Bhagati bhandar = the treasuries of bhagti. Bhagat = those who perform bhagti {Note: the difference between the words 'bhagati' and 'bhagat' is worth remembering}.
O Prabhu! The boundless treasuries of Your bhagti lie brimming full.
Devotion to You, devotion to You, is a treasure overflowing, infinite and beyond measure.
Infinite and innumerable treasures of Yours meditation, Yours meditation, ever remain brimful.
O boundless Hari Ji! The treasuries of Your bhagti — the sense being, the hearts of the bhagats — lie brimming boundlessly full in the three times, and will be so.

Your devotion, Your devotion's treasures overflow, boundless and endless. Your devotees, Your devotees praise You — Lord, they are countless, endless, without limit. Countless, countless perform Your worship, practice austerities, meditate/chant endlessly. Countless read many Simritis and Shastras, and perform the six prescribed rituals. Good are those devotees, O servant Nanak, who are pleasing to my beloved Lord. ||4||
BZ3S: O Hari! Countless and boundless bhagats of Yours are performing Your praise.
Your devotees, Your devotees praise You, Dear Lord, in many and various and countless ways.
In many and various ways, the numberless saint of Yours, saints of Yours, O God! praise You.
O infinite Hari Ji! Your countless bhagats perform Your (salahani) glory in the three times.
20JR: Anik = countless. Tapu = the bodily hardship of dhunis and the like.
O Prabhu! Countless beings perform Your worship. Boundless beings practise tap (in order to meet You).
For You, many, for You, so very many perform worship services, O Dear Infinite Lord; they practice disciplined meditation and chant endlessly.
Good many and servant perform Your, (O Sire) Your worship, O Endless God! They practise penances and repeat Your Name.

O boundless Hari Ji! Your worship is of countless kinds, and for the sake of attaining You countless worshippers go on performing worship, and countless practise tap for You, and countless perform Your jap.
VPRV: Simriti = those religious books which learned Hindu rishis wrote from memory of the Veds for the guidance of their society; their number is about 27. Sasat = the books of the philosophy of the Hindu dharam, six in number: Sankh, Yog, Niai, Vaisheshik, Mimansa, Vedant. Kiria = religious rites. Khatu = six. Khatu karam = according to the Manu-Simriti these six acts are: to study and to teach; to perform yajna and to have yajna performed; to give charity and to receive charity. Karanta = they do.
Countless (servants) of Yours read many Simritis and Shastras (and perform) the six religious acts and other works (which those books prescribe).
For You, many, for You, so very many read the various Simritees and Shaastras. They perform rituals and religious rites.
Many and various men of Yours read many Simirtis and Shashtras. They accomplish rituals and perform six religious rites.

O Akal Purakh Ji! The Shastras that tell of Your form are countless, and the Simritis very many; and countless bhagats of Yours read those Simritis and Shastras, and countless perform the yajna and other karams, and countless perform the six karams.
EG5N: O servant Nanak! Those bhagats alone are good (understand that their labour alone is accepted) who are dear to the beloved Hari-Bhagvant. ||4||
Those devotees, those devotees are sublime, O servant Nanak, who are pleasing to my Dear Lord God. ||4||
Sublime are those saints, you saints, O Servant Nanak! who are pleasing to my auspicious Master.
Sri Guru Ji says: O my Hari Bhagvant Ji, those who seem (bhavahi) good to You, those bhagats are good in the three times. ||4||
DREX: Adi = beginning. Aparanparu = a-paran-par, He whose farthest shore cannot be found, boundless. Tudhu jevadu = as great as You, equal to You. Avaru = other.
O Prabhu! You are the root (of the whole world), You are pervasive in all, You are boundless, You are the creator of all, and there is no other equal to You.
You are the Primal Being, the Most Wonderful Creator. There is no other as Great as You.
You are the primal Being, the most excellent Creator. None else is as great as You.
O Purakh! You are the beginning of all, and aparanpar — the sense being, the creator of all from the ant to Brahma. For this very reason none other is as great as You.
X5GM: Jugu jugu = in every age. Eko = one Himself alone. Nihchalu = unmoving, unshakeable. Vartai = happens.
You alone are Yourself in every age, You are for ever Yourself alone, You are ever-abiding, the creator of all, the one who takes care of all.
Age after age, You are the One. Forever and ever, You are the One. You never change, O Creator Lord.
From age to age You are one and the same, aye and ever, and You are identically the same. Such an ever stable Creator You are.
You are one alone in age after age; again, You are for ever and ever the one non-dual form; and that same You are (nihchalu) the immutable Karta Purakh.
XMW3: O Prabhu! In the world that alone happens which seems good to You Yourself; that alone happens which You Yourself do.
Everything happens according to Your Will. You Yourself accomplish all that occurs.
Whatever You Yourself likest, that comes to pass. What Yourself You actest, that gets accomplished.
O Parmeshvar! That which seems good to You, that alone comes about. That which You Yourself do, that thing happens and will happen.
Z23M: Sabh = whole. Upai = created. Siraji = having created. Ape = Himself. Goi = destroyed.
O Prabhu! The whole creation You Yourself have brought into being. You Yourself, having created it, Yourself destroy it.
You Yourself created the entire universe, and having fashioned it, You Yourself shall destroy it all.
You Yourself created the whole universe and having fashioned You Yourself shall destroy it all.

You Yourself have brought forth the whole creation. You Yourself have again (goi) merged the created creation into Yourself. The sense being this, that creation, sustaining and then dissolution are all done by You.
GMYB: Janoi = the knower. Sabhsai ka = of everyone (of every heart). Soi = the one who takes care ||5||
Servant Nanak sings the virtues of that Creator who is the knower of every being's heart. ||5||1||
Servant Nanak sings the Glorious Praises of the Dear Creator, the Knower of all. ||5||1||
Slave Nanak sings the praises of the Sire Creator, who is the knower of one and all.
Sri Guru Ji says: O Karta Purakh, You who are the begetter of all, or the knower of all — I, becoming Your servant, sing Your virtues alone. ||5||1||
GWN2: Sachiaru = {sach-alay} the house of permanence, the ever-abiding. Maida = my. Sain = master, lord.
(O Prabhu!) You are the creator of all, You are the ever-abiding one, You alone are my Master.
You are the True Creator, my Lord and Master.
O God! You are the true creator, my Master,
O Karta Purakh! You alone are (sachiaru) my true Master.
J4VD: Tau = to You. Bhavai = seems good. Thisi = will be. Hau = haun, I. Pai = pain, I obtain ||1|| Rahau ||
(In the world) that alone happens which is pleasing to You. Whatever You give, that alone do I obtain. ||1|| Rahau ||
Whatever pleases You comes to pass. As You give, so do we receive. ||1||Pause||
That alone happens what pleases You. I receive that what You givest me. Pause.
That which is pleasing to You, that alone happens. What He gives, that alone we obtain. ||1|| Rahau ||
2Q5J: (O Prabhu!) The whole creation is Yours (Your making); all beings remember You alone.
All belong to You, all meditate on you.
All are yours and all meditate on You.
The whole creation is Yours, and all have meditated upon You.
QNAM: He upon whom You show mercy, he alone has found Your jewel-like (precious) Nam.
Those who are blessed with Your Mercy obtain the Jewel of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
He, to whom You showest mercy, obtains the jewel of Your Name.
But he upon whom You show mercy, he alone has obtained Your Nam-jewel from the Gurus.
118H: Gurmukhi = that man whose face is toward the Guru. Manmukhi = that man whose face is toward his own mind.
That man who turned toward the Guru found (this jewel). He who followed his own mind lost it.
The Gurmukhs obtain it, and the self-willed manmukhs lose it.
The pious persons obtain the Name and the self-willed lose it.
For this reason the gurmukhs who have Your grace have (ladha) obtained the Nam-jewel, and the manmukhs bereft of grace have lost the Nam-jewel.
WPW0: (But what is in any being's power? O Prabhu!) You Yourself separate the being (from Yourself), and You Yourself unite him with Yourself. ||1||
You Yourself separate them from Yourself, and You Yourself reunite with them again. ||1||
You Yourself separatest the mortals and Yourself unitest them.
You Yourself have put them far from Yourself, and You Yourself have merged them into Yourself. ||1||
VSZM: (O Prabhu!) You are (as it were) a river (of life); all beings are within You alone (as it were, its waves).
You are the River of Life; all are within You.
You are the river and all are with in You.
O Parmeshvar! You are the stream, and the whole expanse is in the form of waves within You.

You are the river of life, and all are within You. Other than You, there is none other. All living beings are Your play — separated by disunion, then united again by Your will. ||2|| Only the one whom You inspire understands. He constantly speaks and praises the Lord's virtues. One who has served the Lord finds peace, and merges naturally into the Lord's Name. ||3||
ZRNB: Apart from You there is no other (like You).
There is no one except You.
Beside You, there is no one else.
From this, apart from You there is no second at all, because the waves are of the form of the water itself.
X4LD: All these beings and creatures are Your (created) play.
All living beings are Your playthings.
All the sentient-beings are Yours play things
However many beings there are, great and small, all are Your play alone.
R647: Vijogi = because of separation (that is, he upon whose forehead is the writ of separation). Mili = having met, having obtained the human body. Sanjogi = by (the writ of) union. Melu = union ||2||

Those upon whose forehead is the writ of separation remain separated from You even upon obtaining the human birth. (But according to Your will) by the writ of union, union (with You) comes about. ||2||
The separated ones meet, and by great good fortune, those suffering in separation are reunited once again. ||2||
The separated meet, but it is through good luck that the union of the separated is accomplished.

Those who have not had satsang, those manmukhs are separated from union with You. Those gurmukhs who have had the meeting of satsang, they are joined to You. In the Guru's doctrine the name gurmukh is for the seeker or the man of gian, and the name manmukh is for the ignorant. He who keeps the Guru before him is gurmukh; he who keeps his own mind before him is manmukh.
FPYB: Janaihi = You grant understanding. Soi = he alone.
(O Prabhu!) That man to whom You Yourself grant understanding, that man understands (the true way of life).
They alone understand, whom You inspire to understand;
The man, whom you causes to understand, understands You,
O Bhagvan! He whom You, becoming the Guru, cause to know — he alone knows this method.
7906: That man, O Hari, always sings Your virtues, and utters them over and over (to others).
they continually chant and repeat the Lord's Praises.
and he ever utters are repeats Yours praises.
And he alone describes Your virtues daily, night and day.
D9TJ: (O brother!) That man who has remembered the Nam of Parmatma has obtained happiness.
Those who serve You find peace.
He, who has served You, has obtained peace.
O Hari! He who has served You in this manner, he alone has obtained the state of the atma, which is of the form of happiness.
N8TZ: Sahje = sahaji, in spiritual poise. Nami = in the Nam ||3||
That man, abiding always in spiritual poise, becomes absorbed in Prabhu's Nam. ||3||
They are intuitively absorbed into the Lord's Name. ||3||
He easily gets absorbed in Your Name.2
O Hari, possessor of the Nam! That man has merged into You naturally. ||3||

XXG7: Ape = Himself. Kia = done. Sabhu = every work.
(O Prabhu!) You Yourself are the creator of everything; everything that happens is of Your own doing.
You Yourself are the Creator. Everything that happens is by Your Doing.
You Yourself are your Maker. It is by Your doing that everything comes to pass.
O Karta Purakh! You Yourself are the independent Creator; from this, everything that comes about is of Your doing alone.

(the closing lines repeat the same refrain seen at the end of So Purakh above — worth double-checking against IMG_7263, since a repeated refrain is easy to misread as a copy error rather than the text itself.) ||4||2||
FB8H: Apart from You there is no other (like You).
There is no one except You.
Beside You, there is no other second.
And apart from You there is no other creator at all.
C9G1: Vekhahi = You take care. Soi = the state.
Having created the beings, You Yourself take care of them, and You know the state of every heart.
You created the creation; You behold it and understand it.
You beholdest and understandest the created creation of Yours.
You alone, having fashioned the whole creation, are then watching the spectacle, and that same You alone know the secret of the whole creation.

O servant Nanak! In that man who takes the Guru's shelter, Parmatma becomes manifest. ||4||2||
O servant Nanak, the Lord is revealed through the Gurmukh, the Living Expression of the Guru's Word. ||4||2||
Through the Guru, O slave Nanak! God is revealed.
Sri Guru Ji says: to the servants You become manifest by way of the Gurus. ||4||2||
QMNP: We live in this dreadful pool (the world), where the Lord has put the fire of desire in place of water. Stuck in the mud of attachment, the feet do not move — I have watched beings drown there. ||1|| O foolish mind, you do not remember the One God; forgetting the Lord, your virtues waste away. ||1||Pause||
C1M8: Titu = in that {'titu' is the locative singular of the word 'tisu'}. Sarvaru = pool. Sarvarara = fearsome pool. Sarvararai = in the fearsome pool. Titu sarvararai = in that fearsome pool. Bhaile = has become. Pavaku = fire, the fire of craving. Tinahi = that (Prabhu) Himself.
(O brother! We beings) dwell in that fearsome (world-) pool, in which that Prabhu Himself has made fire (of craving) in place of water.
In that pool, people have made their homes, but the water there is as hot as fire!
Man has obtained an abode in that world-pool, whose water that Lord has made hot as fire.
O mind! See, in this world-pool your dwelling has come to be, in which are the waters of shabad, touch, form, taste and smell.
3BMK: Pank = mire. Pank ju moh = the mire which is attachment. Pagu = foot. Ham dekha = before our very eyes. Tah = in that (pool). Dubiale = they drowned, they are drowning ||1||

(And in that fearsome pool) there is the mire of attachment, in which the being's foot cannot move (beings are stuck fast in the mire of attachment). Before our own eyes (countless beings, caught in the mire of attachment) are drowning in that (fathomless sea of the fire of craving). ||1||
In the swamp of emotional attachment, their feet cannot move. I have seen them drowning there. ||1||
In the mire of worldly love, his feet move on not. I have seen him drowning there-in.

There is the fire of trishna, there is the mire in the form of moh, caught in which the foot in the form of the buddhi cannot walk toward Parmeshvar. In that pool we have seen the manmukhs (dubiale) drowning. ||1|| Or: the dwelling has come to be in that pool which is the satsang, where the sants have by contentment turned the fire of asa and trishna into water — that is to say, have quieted it. By the word 'pankaj' understand the lotus feet. Those who have become enamoured of the lotus feet of Bhagvant, they (nahi chalai) do not waver. We have seen that those sants stay plunged and immersed, (dubiale) having taken a dip, in that very relish. ||1||
DM2A: Man = O mind! Murh mana = O foolish mind!
O mind! O foolish mind! You do not remember the one Parmatma.
In your mind, you do not remember the One Lord-you fool!
O foolish man! why rememberest you not the unique Lord in your mind.
O foolish mind! You do not, with one-pointed mind, remember Parmeshvar.
35VY: Galia = are dissolving away, are diminishing ||1|| Rahau ||
As you go on forgetting Parmatma, so your virtues (within you) go on diminishing. ||1|| Rahau ||
You have forgotten the Lord; your virtues shall wither away. ||1||Pause||
By forgetting God, your virtues, O man! shall wither away. Pause.

That is to say, remember Hari; otherwise, from the forgetting of Hari, all the virtues you have will dissolve away, that is, become useless. Or, from forgetting Hari a rope will fall around your (galia) neck.
PBVU: Hau = I. Jati = one who makes effort to restrain the desire of kam. Sati = one of high conduct. Mugadh = foolish, senseless. Janamu = life.

(O Prabhu!) I am neither a man of continence, nor a man of high conduct, nor am I learned; my life has become that of a foolish and senseless man. (That is: continence, conduct and learning cannot save one from falling into this fire of craving and mire of attachment. If a man forgets Prabhu, then even with continence, conduct and learning his life is that of the greatest fool.)
I am not celibate, nor truthful, nor scholarly. I was born foolish and ignorant into this world.
I am not a continent or a true man nor a scholar, Foolish and ignorant, I am born in this world.
From this, O mind! Make your supplication in this manner: O Akal Purakh! I am neither a man of continence, nor of truth, nor learned; rather, through great foolishness my birth has become fruitless.
A1MY: So Nanak makes supplication: (O Prabhu! Keep me) in the shelter of those (gurmukhs) by whom You are not forgotten (from whom Your remembrance has not slipped). ||2||3||
Prays Nanak, I seek the Sanctuary of those who have not forgotten You, O Lord! ||2||3||
Pray Nanak! I have sought the sanctuary of those who forget You not,(O Lord!).
Sri Guru Ji says: I have fallen into the shelter of those sants whom You are not forgotten by. ||2||3||
YTAK: You have obtained this precious human body; this is your opportunity to meet the Lord of the Universe. Says Nanak, we are of lowly deeds — protect the honour of those who have come to Your shelter. ||2||4||
Y2GA: Bhai parapati = has been obtained. Dehuria = beautiful body. Manukh dehuria = the beautiful human body.
(O brother!) You have obtained the beautiful human body.
This human body has been given to you.
This human body has come to your hand.
O brother! This human body which has been obtained —
4RGG: For you this is the very occasion for meeting Parmatma.
This is your chance to meet the Lord of the Universe.
This is your chance to meet the Lord of the world.
this alone is your (baria) turn, that is to say the occasion, for meeting Gobind.
QSEF: Avari = all others {avaru = singular. Avari = plural}.
(If no effort is made to meet Prabhu, then) all your other works are of no use to you at all (they will bring no benefit to your soul).
Other works are of no avail to you.
And however many the affairs, they will not come to your use at all.
6LJU: (For this reason) keep sitting together in the sadh sangat, and (even sitting in the sadh sangat) remember only the Nam of Parmatma. (Sitting in the sadh sangat is of benefit only if there you join yourself to the praise of Parmatma.) ||1||
Join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; vibrate and meditate on the Jewel of the Naam. ||1||
Joining the society of saints, contemplate over the Name alone.
From this, join the sangat of the sadhs, and repeat the Nam alone. ||1||
RZ95: Saranjami = in the arrangement, in the business. Lagu = apply yourself. Bhavjal = the world-ocean. Taran kai saranjami = in the business of crossing over.
(O brother!) Set yourself (also) to the business of crossing the world-ocean.
Make every effort to cross over this terrifying world-ocean.
Make effort for crossing the dreadful world-ocean.
O brother! Apply yourself to the (saranjami) effort of crossing over the ocean which is the world.

EJU3: The bani 'Sohila' of Guru Nanak Ji, in Rag Gauri-Dipaki.
Sohilaa ~ The Song Of Praise. Raag Gauree Deepakee, First Mehl:
Song of praise. Gouri Deepeki Measure, First Guru.

Sohila is the name of the praise (jas) of Parmeshvar. Just as there are three sandhyas of the three times — morning, midday and evening — so in the Guru Ji's doctrine there is at dawn the path of 'Japu' Ji, and in the evening the path of 'Rahiras', and at the time of retiring to sleep the path of 'Sohila': these are the three sandhyas. The greatness (mahatam) of this Sohila is made known thus. In the town of Sri Kartarpur, at some time at midday, Sri Guru Nanak Dev Ji — the doer and the cause — was resting. Sri Guru Angad Ji was performing the service of His feet. Seeing that a mere trace of blood had appeared on the feet, he asked; then the word came from the sacred mouth: 'A certain goatherd was going about among the thorn-bushes doing the path of the Sohila, and I too was following behind, listening — from this the thorns have pricked me. For wherever anyone recites the Arti Sohila, there I listen. So give him the updesh that he should do the path at the time of retiring, and not at other times.' This maryada of the Sohila has run from the first Guru Ji. The path of three shabads continued to be done. At one time, before the Fifth Guru Ji, a Vanjara Sikh made a request: 'O True Emperor! We people have to stay in foreign lands, in fearsome places, on account of thieves and ghosts and the like. So, showing grace, speak such a mantra by which our protection may be secured in every way.'

7JT8: 15 blinks of the eye = 1 visa. 15 visue = 1 chasa. 30 chase = 1 pal. 60 pal = 1 ghari. 7 and a half gharis = 1 pahar. 8 pahar = 1 day and night. 15 thits; 7 days of the week; 12 months, six seasons.

The fragrance of sandal wood makes Your incense, wind Your fan and all the vegetation Yours flowers, O Luminous Lord!

The more they walk away (from God) the more it pricks and more the pain they suffer and they bear on their heads the mace of death's myrmidon.

God's men are absorbed in Lord God's Name and they have broken away the pangs and fear of birth and death.

Those who are the servants of Hari remain undivided (abhed) in the Nam of Hari Hari. They have shattered, have brought to nothing, that pain of birth and death which is (bhav) in the world; or, the pain of birth and death which (bhav) had arisen — that they have brought to nothing.

They come to meet the imperishable, all-pervading Parmesar. Their glory spreads through all the khands and brahmands. ||3||

They have obtained the imperishable supreme Lord God and great honour is theirs in the various regions and universes.
O brother! Those gurmukhs who have obtained Parmeshvar Purakh, who is free of destruction — their great glory is spreading in the khands and brahmands. ||3||
6SJW: Maskin = helpless. Prabh = O Prabhu. Rakhu = protect.
O Prabhu! We beings are the poor beggars at Your door. You are the greatest helper of all. Save us (from these kamadiks).

I am poor and humble but I am Yours, O Lord God! Save me, save me, O You greatest, of the great.

O brother! Therefore make your supplication in this manner: O Hari, greater than the great, we are Your poor (maskin), Your most lowly servants. O Hari! Protect us from the ocean of existence, and keep us within Your own sharan.
BV7S: Adharu = support. Name = in the Nam alone. Manda = obtained. ||4||
O Prabhu! To Your servant Nanak Your Nam alone is the support, Your Nam alone is the prop. Only by being joined to Your Nam is happiness obtained. ||4||4||
Servant Nanak takes the Sustenance and Support of the Naam. In the Name of the Lord, he enjoys celestial peace. ||4||4||
The Name is slave Nanak's sustenance and support and by God's Name he enjoys peace.

Sri Guru Ji says: O Master! To us servants there is the support of Your Nam alone, of the bani alone; and of Your Nam alone is the (tek) prop of the body. And O Hari! By Your Nam alone has our mind (manda) taken hold of happiness.

O my friends! Listen! I make a supplication — (now) is the time for doing the service of the gurmukhs.
Listen, my friends, I beg of you: now is the time to serve the Saints!

O my friends! Listen, I speak by way of supplication. This very human body is the (vela) time for doing the seva of the sants. In this world, earn the profit of the Lord's Name, and hereafter, you shall dwell in peace. ||1||
Over here, earn the profit of God's Name and depart, here-after, you shall have adorned, abode.
(Ihan) In this human body, if you go having earned the profit of the jap of Hari's Nam, then ahead in the next world your dwelling will be (suhela) the giver of happiness. ||1||
XH0Q: O mind! Day and night (passing and passing) the lifespan keeps diminishing.

O mind! The lifespan goes on diminishing by night and day.

O (my) mind! Having met the Guru, bring the work (of human life) to completion. ||1|| Rahau ||

This world is engrossed in wickedness and scepticism. God's divine alone, is saved.
O brother! This world-ocean, which is filled with the vikars of the sense-objects and with doubts — from this some brahm-giani has crossed over.

He, whom God awakens to drink this essence of His Name, comes to know the discourse of the ineffable Lord.

That brahm-giani Satiguru, having awakened from the sleep of moh whichever sleeping being, causes him to drink the relish of the Nam — that one has known the discourse of (akathu) Akal Purakh; the sense being, to that one alone has the direct experience come.

Purchase only that commodity for which you have come. Through Guru's grace God shall dwell within your heart.

Therefore, O Sikhs! That very wealth of Hari's Nam for which you have come into the world — (bihajhahu) purchase it from the Gurus; that is, bring about the dwelling of Hari's Nam in the mind by way of the Gurus.

Within the home of your own inner being, you shall obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence with intuitive ease. You shall not be consigned again to the wheel of reincarnation. ||3||
In the own home you shall obtain the Lord's presence in comfort and ease and you shall not undergo the round again.

Then in the nij ghar, which is the form of one's own bliss (nijanand sarup), you will obtain it in sahaj itself. Then the round of birth and death will not be yours again. Therefore make your supplication in this manner.
D1VS: Antarjami = O Knower of hearts! Purakh = O You pervading in all! Bidhate = O Creator! Pure = puri, fulfil.

O Lord! the searcher of hearts and the designer of chances, fulfill my heart's yearning.
O Antarjami, O Bidhata Purakh! Fulfil the sardha of my mind.

Servant Nanak begs this happiness of You, that You make me the dust of the feet of the sants. ||4||5||
Nanak, Your slave, begs for this happiness: let me be the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||4||5||
Servant Nanak asks for this happiness ; Make me the dust of the feet of Yours Saints, (O Lord!)4

Sri Guru Ji says! I, Your servant, beg this happiness alone: that You cause me to obtain the dust of the feet of those sants — the sense being this, that the sadh sangat may not be parted from me. ||4||5|| ☬ At one time Sri Guru Nanak Dev Ji was seated at Jagannath upon the shore of the sea. Then a most fearsome darkness arose; seeing it, Mardana became terrified, and closing his eyes and drawing a cloth over his face, he fell down. In that moment Kalyug came, having assumed a most fearsome form. Sri Guru Ji remained seated, unmoved. Then, knowing Him to be of the greater majesty, it came and fell at His feet and began to make praise, and said: O Bhagvan! I am the king of this age. Pearls and other jewels, and beautiful mansions, and riddhi and siddhi, and kingdoms and the rest, are all under my command. So, showing grace, accept some offering of mine also. Then, for the sake of giving it an answer, He uttered the shabad as a supplication before Sri Akal Purakh Ji. Kalyug's intent was this: that when I have deluded the Guru Ji with the vibhutis, and have not let the people gain benefit from His updesh, then my writ will remain established over all. In this same way, when He went to Bishnu for the sake of bathing in the Bein, then, facing Him, He made this supplication:

Without God my soul is scorched and burnt down.

were I to become non-apparent and apparent at will, and thereby people may have regard for me.

May it not be that a beholding them I may go amiss, forget You and remember not Your Name.

and seated on the throne, were I to issue commands and collect revenue; O Nanak! all this is liable to pass away like a puff of wind.

May it not be that on beholding them I may go amiss, forget You and remember not Your Name.

The True Formless Lord's is in His own place.

As I have often heard, I narrate the tale of Yours excellences,(O Lord!) if it pleases You, induce Your craving in me. Pause.

Were I to be slashed and cut into pieces, over and over again, and put in a quern, and ground.
8EQV: burnt by fire and mixed with ashes
Were I to be burnt with fire and mingled with ashes;
Z90A: -even then, I could not estimate Your Value. How can I describe the Greatness of Your Name? ||2||
Even so I would not be able to assess Your value. How great should I call Your Name?
3ACG: If I was a bird, soaring and flying through hundreds of heavens,
Becoming a bird, were I to hover and soar through hundreds of heavens,

and were I to vanish from every one's gaze and neither drink not eat anything.5

Even so I cannot appraise your worth. How great shall I call Your Name?

Even so I cannot appraise your worth. How great shall I call Your Name?

In account the man speaks the words, in accounts he partakes of the food.
J72A: As it is pre-ordained, they walk along the way. As it is pre-ordained, they see and hear.
In account he walks along the way, In account he hearts and sees.

In account he draws the breath. Why should I go to ask the literate?
VULP: O Baba, the splendor of Maya is deceptive.
O Father! deceitful is the splendor of worldly object.

The (spiritually) blind man has forgotten God's Name. He neither abides in peace in this world nor in the next. Pause.

Life and death are for everything that is born. Death devours everything here.
ZTBF: He sits and examines the accounts, there where no one goes along with anyone.
Where the (Righteous Judge) sits and explains the account, thither no one goes with the man.
YG3A: Those who weep and wail might just as well all tie bundles of straw. ||2||
The weepers, one and all, tie bundles of straw.

All say that the Lord is the greatest of the great. None calls Him less.
4BJV: No one can estimate His Worth. By speaking of Him, His Greatness is not increased.
No one has ascertained His worth. He becomes not great just by saying.

You alone are the True Lord of mine and other being of numberless worlds.

Those who are of low caste among the lowly, rather the lowest of the low;

Nanak seeks the company of those. Why should he rival the lofty?

Where the poor are looked after, there does rain the look of Your grace, O Lord!

Avarice is a dog, falsehood the sweeper and cheating the eating of a carrion.
X0YP: Slandering others is putting the filth of others into your own mouth. The fire of anger is the outcaste who burns dead bodies at the crematorium.
Slandering others, solely amounts to putting other's filth in ones own mouth and fire of wrath is pariah.
W6PF: I am caught in these tastes and flavors, and in self-conceited praise. These are my actions, O my Creator! ||1||
In such sins, sweet and saline savour, and self-praise, I am engrossed, These are my doings, O my Creator.

O Brother! utter the words which may bring honour.
Y4YQ: They alone are good, who are judged good at the Lord's Door. Those with bad karma can only sit and weep. ||1||Pause||
Good are they who are styled good in Lord's Court. The devilish sit and bewail. Pause.

The pleasure of gold, pleasure of silvers and damsels, pleasure of fragrance of sandal,

pleasure of horses, pleasure of common cushion with a houri and a palace, pleasure of sweets and pleasure of meats,

So many are the relishes of the human body. How can then God's Name secure an abode within the heart?
PY18: Those words are acceptable, which, when spoken, bring honor.
The words by speaking which honour is obtained that utterance of the worlds becomes acceptable.
TSQT: Harsh words bring only grief. Listen, O foolish and ignorant mind!
By uttering harsh words man come to grief. Hearken, O my foolish ignorant soul!
F1NX: Those who are pleasing to Him are good. What else is there to be said? ||3||
They, who are pleasing to Him, are good, what else is to be said or described?
KN6M: Wisdom, honor and wealth are in the laps of those whose hearts remain permeated with the Lord.
Wisdom honour and wealth in the lap of those in whose mind God remains permeated.
NDEV: What praise can be offered to them? What other adornments can be bestowed upon them?
What praise of theirs can one chime? What more decoration they need?
SGMH: O Nanak, those who lack the Lord's Glance of Grace cherish neither charity nor the Lord's Name. ||4||4||
Nanak, they who are bereft of God's gracious glance cherish not fondness charity and the Name.
KR2R: The Great Giver has given the intoxicating drug of falsehood.
The Giver has given man intoxicating pill of falsehood.
GJ0W: The people are intoxicated; they have forgotten death, and they have fun for a few days.
Having been intoxicated therewith he has forgotten death and makes merry for four days.
9PHL: Those who do not use intoxicants are true; they dwell in the Court of the Lord. ||1||
The mortals, who are the nonusers of intoxicants, obtain truthfulness to keep them in God's Court.
GK8P: O Nanak, know the True Lord as True.
O Nanak! know the True Lord alone as True.
71N1: Serving Him, peace is obtained; you shall go to His Court with honor. ||1||Pause||
By serving whom the mortal attains peace and goes to Yours Court with honour O Lord! Pause.
ZVZE: The Wine of Truth is not fermented from molasses. The True Name is contained within it.
The wine of truth is prepared without molasses and in that there is the True Name.6

BDUG: I am a sacrifice to those who hear and chant the True Name.
I am a sacrifice to all those who hear and repeat (the True Name).
0K0T: Only one who obtains a room in the Mansion of the Lord's Presence is deemed to be truly intoxicated. ||2||
Only then the man is deemed to be intoxicated when he obtains room in God's mansion.
LV2F: Bathe in the waters of Goodness and apply the scented oil of Truth to your body,
Take bath in the water of virtues and apply the perfume of sandal of righteousness to the body,
77N7: and your face shall become radiant. This is the gift of 100,000 gifts.
then shall your face become bright. This is the gift of a hundred thousand gifts.
WWCP: Tell your troubles to the One who is the Source of all comfort. ||3||
Tell yours woes to Him, with whom rest all the weals.
HL02: How can you forget the One who created your soul, and the praanaa, the breath of life?
Why should we in our mind grow oblivious of Him who is the owner of our soul and life.
RQE4: Without Him, all that we wear and eat is impure.
Without Him all vestures and viand are impure.
X0FU: Everything else is false. Whatever pleases Your Will is acceptable. ||4||5||
All other things are false. What pleases You, (O Lord!) becomes acceptable.
5QNH: Burn emotional attachment, and grind it into ink. Transform your intelligence into the purest of paper.
Burnt wordly love and pound it into ink and turn your intelligence into superior paper.
770T: Make the love of the Lord your pen, and let your consciousness be the scribe. Then, seek the Guru's Instructions, and record these deliberations.
Make Lord's love your pen, mind the scribe and write God's deliberation after consulting the Guru.

Pen down the praises of God's Name and continuously write that He has no end and limit.
RH1Q: O Baba, write such an account,
O Brother! learn how to write this account,

so that where an account is called for, there you mayest have a true Mark. Pause.

where honours everlasting bliss and eternal raptures are bestowed.

If man becomes the recipient of God's grace, then alone does he obtain such honours and not by idle words.

Some come, some get up and depart. They give themselves high name.

Some are beggar born and some hold huge courts.

By going into the beyond man shall realise that without the Name he is of no account.
PWH0: I am terrified by the Fear of You, God. Bothered and bewildered, my body is wasting away.
I am greatly afraid of Yours awe, (O Lord!) and being distracted and bothered my body is wasting away.

Nanak, when the mortal arises and depart, all the false affections are sundered.

to utter it with the mouth is sweet savoury and to hymn God's Name I have made my spices.

The love of the unique Lord is the thirty-six sorts of flavoury Nectars (victuals). This is the way of those on whom He casts His gracious glance.

O Brother! ruinous is the happiness of other viand,

by eating which the body is crushed and sin enters the mind. Pause.

Contentment is my waist-band and Your Name, (O Lord,!) my wealth and youth.

Nanak, the True King takes decision without seeking other's counsel.

TXG1: with the face anointed at the sixty-eight holy places of pilgrimage, and the heart illuminated with wisdom
On his face He bears the sacred mark of having taken bath at sixty-eight places of pilgrimage.
BKJN: -with that wisdom, chant the Praises of the True Name, the Treasure of Excellence. ||1||
By that understanding he sings the praises of the True Name, the treasure of excellences.
9008: O Baba, other wisdom is useless and irrelevant.
O Brother! another intelligence is altogether alien (to the spiritual realm).
QZ91: If falsehood is practiced a hundred times, it is still false in its effects. ||1||Pause||
If falsehood be practised a hundred times it still continues to have false force. Pause.
U0CW: You may be worshipped and adored as a Pir (a spiritual teacher); you may be welcomed by all the world;
If man be adored and called a spiritual guide and be counted among men of occult powers,
ZXPS: you may adopt a lofty name, and be known to have supernatural spiritual powers
He may call himself by high name and the entire world may welcome him,
0ZLQ: -even so, if you are not accepted in the Court of the Lord, then all this adoration is false. ||2||
But if he becomes not acceptable at the Spouse's Court, then all the worship will make him miserable.
CARQ: No one can overthrow those who have been established by the True Guru.
None can unseat then whom the True Guru has installed.
DAXD: The Treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is within them, and through the Naam, they are radiant and famous.
Within then is the Name treasure and through the Name they are renowned.
5J3W: They worship the Naam, and they believe in the Naam. The True One is forever Intact and Unbroken. ||3||
They worship God's Name and believe in nothing but the Name. Ever imperishable is that True Lord.
XF96: When the body mingles with dust, what happens to the soul?
What would then happen to the soul when the body is mingled with dust.
SAS5: All clever tricks are burnt away, and you shall depart crying.
All the cleavernesses of man get burnt (come to an end) and he departs weeping.
GFUS: O Nanak, those who forget the Naam-what will happen when they go to the Court of the Lord? ||4||8||
Nanak, if man forgets God's Name what treatment shall be meted out to him on his arrival at God's Court.
P5PA: The virtuous wife exudes virtue; the unvirtuous suffer in misery.
The virtuous wife repeats the virtues (of Her Spouse) and the virtueless one repents.
ZZK5: If you long for your Husband Lord, O soul-bride, you must know that He is not met by falsehood.
O Woman if you desirest your Bridegroom then the consort can not be met through falsehood.
UU89: No boat or raft can take you to Him. Your Husband Lord is far away. ||1||
Your Beloved is far off. You cannot meet Him. There is no boat nor a raft (to ferry you across).
19EL: My Lord and Master is Perfect; His Throne is Eternal and Immovable.
My Lord is perfect. His throne is immovable.
CXLF: One who attains perfection as Gurmukh, obtains the Immeasurable True Lord. ||1||Pause||
If the Exalted Guru makes the mortal perfect he procures the immeasurable True Lord. Pause.
0GH4: The Palace of the Lord God is so beautiful.
Lord God's palace is beautiful. It is studded with flawless diamonds,
MMBG: Within it, there are gems, rubies, pearls and flawless diamonds. A fortress of gold surrounds this Source of Nectar.
gems, rubies and pearls. It is surrounded by a golden fort and is the home of Nectar.
BHMQ: How can I climb up to the Fortress without a ladder? By meditating on the Lord, through the Guru, I am blessed and exalted. ||2||
How shall I scale the fortress without a ladder? By meditation on God, through the Guru, I shall behold that.
F0QZ: The Guru is the Ladder, the Guru is the Boat, and the Guru is the Raft to take me to the Lord's Name.
(To have access to God's Name) the Guru is the ladder, the Guru the boat and the Guru the raft.
WAUV: The Guru is the Boat to carry me across the world-ocean; the Guru is the Sacred Shrine of Pilgrimage, the Guru is the Holy River.
The Guru is (my) ship to cross sin's lake and world's ocean and the Guru is (my) place of pilgrimage and sacred stream.
KQNT: If it pleases Him, I bathe in the Pool of Truth, and become radiant and pure. ||3||
If it pleases Him, I shall go to bathe in the true tank and become pure.
GXPC: He is called the Most Perfect of the Perfect. He sits upon His Perfect Throne.
Perfect of the perfect the Lord is called. He reposes on the perfect throne.
KX0Y: He looks so Beautiful in His Perfect Place. He fulfills the hopes of the hopeless.
He Looks Beautiful on His Perfect seat and fulfils the hopes of the hopeless.
DEW4: O Nanak, if one obtains the Perfect Lord, how can his virtues decrease? ||4||9||
Nanak, if man obtains the Perfect Master, how can his virtues decrease?
7ADR: Come, my dear sisters and spiritual companions; hug me close in your embrace.
Come My sisters and dear comrades! clasp me in yours embrace.
YNB5: Let's join together, and tell stories of our All-powerful Husband Lord.
Meeting together let us tell the tales of our Omnipotent Spouse.
TM80: All Virtues are in our True Lord and Master; we are utterly without virtue. ||1||
In the true Lord are all merits, in us all demerits.
WTHP: O Creator Lord, all are in Your Power.
O My Creator! all are in Your power.
QT7D: I dwell upon the One Word of the Shabad. You are mine-what else do I need? ||1||Pause||
I contemplate over the One Name, when you are mine, O Lord! what more do I require then. Pause.
ERS5: Go, and ask the happy soul-brides, "By what virtuous qualities do you enjoy your Husband Lord?"
Go and ask the happy wives by what merits did they enjoy their Spouse
8T7Z: "We are adorned with intuitive ease, contentment and sweet words.
(They say:) with the decorations of Divine knowledge, contentment and sweet discourses.
VVJN: We meet with our Beloved, the Source of Joy, when we listen to the Word of the Guru's Shabad." ||2||
If she hearkens to the Guru's instructions, it is then, that the Joyous Beloved meets.

FG00: You have so many Creative Powers, Lord; Your Bountiful Blessings are so Great.
How many are yours omnipotences and how great Yours gifts, (O Master?)
RRY0: So many of Your beings and creatures praise You day and night.
Innumerable are your creatures who utter (Yours) praises day and night.
8J2P: You have so many forms and colors, so many classes, high and low. ||3||
Innumerable are Yours forms and colours and numberless Yours castes, high and low.
P39N: Meeting the True One, Truth wells up. The truthful are absorbed into the True Lord.
By meeting the True Guru truth is produced and becoming truthful man is absorbed in the True Lord.
RCP5: Intuitive understanding is obtained and one is welcomed with honor, through the Guru's Word, filled with the Fear of God.
When by the Guru's teachings the mortal is filled with Divine fear he obtains understanding and honour welcome him.
1PDG: O Nanak, the True King absorbs us into Himself. ||4||10||
O Nanak! the True King Himself then blends man with His ownself.
NRKV: It all worked out-I was saved, and the egotism within my heart was subdued.
It turned out well that I was saved and my pride was stilled in my heart.
8RVK: The evil energies have been made to serve me, since I placed my faith in the True Guru.
When I reposed confidence in the True Guru (my) enemies then began to perform (my) service.
NEAB: I have renounced my useless schemes, by the Grace of the True, Carefree Lord. ||1||
(By the grace of) the Care-free True Lord I have renounced the useless head-ache.
ZUAZ: O mind, meeting with the True One, fear departs.
Fear depart by meeting the True One, O Man!
HKFM: Without the Fear of God, how can anyone become fearless? Become Gurmukh, and immerse yourself in the Shabad. ||1||Pause||
Without God's fear and blending with His Name through the Guru, how can the mortal become fearless? Pause.
BHTD: How can we describe Him with words? There is no end to the descriptions of Him.
How for can His exposition be given? There is no end the God's descriptions.
TLBT: There are so many beggars, but He is the only Giver.
There are good many mumpers, He alone is the Giver.
ES5R: He is the Giver of the soul, and the praanaa, the breath of life; when He dwells within the mind, there is peace. ||2||
Solace accrues when He, who is the owner of soul and life, abides in (man's) mind.
BVFN: The world is a drama, staged in a dream. In a moment, the play is played out.
This world is like a drama staged in a dream, in a moment this play ends.
BFYK: Some attain union with the Lord, while others depart in separation.
Some attain to Master union and others in separation.
784K: Whatever pleases Him comes to pass; nothing else can be done. ||3||
Whatever pleases Him, that comes to pass. Nothing else can be done.
WA6A: The Gurmukhs purchase the Genuine Article. The True Merchandise is purchased with the True Capital.
Through the Guru, purchase the Divine commodity. The True merchandise is bought with the true Capital.
YBNL: Those who purchase this True Merchandise through the Perfect Guru are blessed.
Hail! to those, who, through the Perfect Guru, have purchased the True Name.
QWQF: O Nanak, one who stocks this True Merchandise shall recognize and realize the Genuine Article. ||4||11||
O Nanak! (the Lord,) who stocks real merchandise, shall recongnise their commodity.
4TPZ: As metal merges with metal, those who chant the Praises of the Lord are absorbed into the Praiseworthy Lord.
As a metal ultimately merges in metal, so does a praise-chanter gets absorbed in the Praise -worthy Lord.
2RSN: Like the poppies, they are dyed in the deep crimson color of Truthfulness.
Like the poppy flower he is dyed deep red in the colour of truthfulness.
YK0Y: Those contented souls who meditate on the Lord with single-minded love, meet the True Lord. ||1||
The content, who meditate on God with single love, meet the True One.
VHUC: O Siblings of Destiny, become the dust of the feet of the humble Saints.
O Brother! become the dust of the feet of saintly persons.
BP5D: In the Society of the Saints, the Guru is found. He is the Treasure of Liberation, the Source of all good fortune. ||1||Pause||
Guru, the wealth of salvation giver, elysian cow, is obtained in the society of saints. Pause.
EDPS: Upon that Highest Plane of Sublime Beauty, stands the Mansion of the Lord.
The mansion of God the destroyer of spiritual ignorance is on the beauteous raised platform.
6AMN: By true actions, this human body is obtained, and the door within ourselves which leads to the Mansion of the Beloved, is found.
Through good deeds human body is obtained and through Divine love the door of Lord home and palace.
870D: The Gurmukhs train their minds to contemplate the Lord, the Supreme Soul. ||2||
It is through the meditation of the Omnipresent Soul that the holy instruct their mind.
FBJX: By actions committed under the influence of the three qualities, hope and anxiety are produced.
By doing three pronged deed hope and anxiety are produced.
E6MR: Without the Guru, how can anyone be released from these three qualities? Through intuitive wisdom, we meet with Him and find peace.
How can one be released from the bondage of three qualities without the Guru? it is by acquiring Divine knowledge that comfort ensues.
XKTJ: Within the home of the self, the Mansion of His Presence is realized when He bestows His Glance of Grace and washes away our pollution. ||3||
By casting His gracious glance, God washes off man's filth and in his very home (body) he comes to realise Lord's presence.
7WXH: Without the Guru, this pollution is not removed. Without the Lord, how can there be any homecoming?
Without the Guru pollution is not removed and without God how can there be home coming?
Z4UQ: Contemplate the One Word of the Shabad, and abandon other hopes.
Having renounced other hopes, we ought to meditate on the Name alone.
YU5G: O Nanak, I am forever a sacrifice to the one who beholds, and inspires others to behold Him. ||4||12||
O Nanak! I am ever a sacrifice (to the Guru) who Himself beholds and causes others to behold (God).
YSFY: The life of the discarded bride is cursed. She is deceived by the love of duality.
Accursed is the life of the discarded bride, as she is deluded by another's love.
AF2E: Like a wall of sand, day and night, she crumbles, and eventually, she breaks down altogether.
Like the wall containing calcareous matter, day and night, she continues crumbling (and finally) falls down.
AXGY: Without the Word of the Shabad, peace does not come. Without her Husband Lord, her suffering does not end. ||1||
Without the Name peace ensues not, without the Beloved grief does not depart.
EP5V: O soul-bride, without your Husband Lord, what good are your decorations?
O Bride! of what avail is your adornment without your Bridegroom?9

KVSA: In this world, you shall not find any shelter; in the world hereafter, being false, you shall suffer. ||1||Pause||
In mansion's door (this world) you shall obtain no shelter and being false you shall be miserable in the next world. Pause.
3DS0: The True Lord Himself knows all; He makes no mistakes. He is the Great Farmer of the Universe.
The True Lord Himself is all wise and forgets not. He is a great husbandman.
K4JU: First, He prepares the ground, and then He plants the Seed of the True Name.
He first prepares the mind ground and then gives (sows) the seed of the True Name.
E3J9: The nine treasures are produced from Name of the One Lord. By His Grace, we obtain His Banner and Insignia. ||2||
From the Name of One Lord the nine treasure are produced and the mortal comes to bear the mark of His grace.
7MFC: Some are very knowledgeable, but if they do not know the Guru, then what is the use of their lives?
What is the sense and life conduct of him. who understanding (withstanding), understands not the Guru.
VVSC: The blind have forgotten the Naam, the Name of the Lord. The self-willed manmukhs are in utter darkness.
The Blind man has forgotten the Name. A perverse person (walks) in pitch-darkness.
UTX1: Their comings and goings in reincarnation do not end; through death and rebirth, they are wasting away. ||3||
His coming and going ceases not and he is ruined in death and birth.
8MTR: The bride may buy sandalwood oil and perfumes, and apply them in great quantities to her hair;
She buys and brings sandal, saffron redhead for the partings of her hair.
UNDV: she may sweeten her breath with betel leaf and camphor,
Moreover she applies to her body in great abundance the perfume of eagle and sandal wood and chews betel leaf mixed with camphor.
TXGX: but if this bride is not pleasing to her Husband Lord, then all these trappings are false. ||4||
But If the bride is not pleasing to her Spouse then all her trappings are false.
GADR: Her enjoyment of all pleasures is futile, and all her decorations are corrupt.
Her enjoyments of all the pleasure are vain and all her decorations unwholesome.
CCZ7: Until she has been pierced through with the Shabad, how can she look beautiful at Guru's Gate?
Until she is pierced through with God's Name how can she look beautiful in Great God's Court?
GFS2: O Nanak, blessed is that fortunate bride, who is in love with her Husband Lord. ||5||13||
Nanak, blessed is the fortunate wife, who bears love with (to) her Consort.
5JVK: The empty body is dreadful, when the soul goes out from within.
When the soul departs from within, dreadful becomes the forlorn body.
GK44: The burning fire of life is extinguished, and the smoke of the breath no longer emerges.
The burning fire is extinguished and now no smoke of breath emerges.
WW6X: The five relatives (the senses) weep and wail painfully, and waste away through the love of duality. ||1||
The five (sense-organs) bewail painfully and pine away through worldly love.
FEN9: You fool: chant the Name of the Lord, and preserve your virtue.
O fool! preserve virtues and remember Pervading God.
S256: Egotism and possessiveness are very enticing; egotistical pride has plundered everyone. ||1||Pause||
Self-conceit and egoism are bewitching. Arrogance has defrauded all. Pause.
QH95: Those who have forgotten the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are attached to affairs of duality.
They, who have forgotten the Name, are attached with worldly pursuits,
3R7C: Attached to duality, they putrefy and die; they are filled with the fire of desire within.
are linked with another in love and they within whose heart is the fire of desire, putrefy to death.
MMYT: Those who are protected by the Guru are saved; all others are cheated and plundered by deceitful worldly affairs. ||2||
They, whom the Guru protects are saved and others, are beguiled by deceitful worldly occupations.
MP2Q: Love dies, and affection vanishes. Hatred and alienation die.
The pious persons for ever restrain their desires and by becoming the recipients of His favour obtain the True Being.
B3G4: Entanglements end, and egotism dies, along with attachment to Maya, possessiveness and anger.
Their profane affection dies, their worldly love goes and they cease their enmity and estrangement.
AGS1: Those who receive His Mercy obtain the True One. The Gurmukhs dwell forever in balanced restraint. ||3||
Their secular avocations come to an end and die down their pride, worldly attachments yearning for wealth and wrath.
N874: By true actions, the True Lord is met, and the Guru's Teachings are found.
By true service one meets the True Lord and obtains Guru's instruction.
LTFJ: Then, they are not subject to birth and death; they do not come and go in reincarnation.
That man gets immune of birth and death. He neither comes nor goes.
85F7: O Nanak, they are respected at the Lord's Gate; they are robed in honor in the Court of the Lord. ||4||14||
Nanak, he is prominent at God's door and goes to His Court clad with the robe of honour.
D4SH: The body is burnt to ashes; by its love of Maya, the mind is rusted through.
The body is completely burnt to ashes and because of mammon's love the mind is rusted with wickedness.
MG3U: Demerits become one's enemies, and falsehood blows the bugle of attack.
Demerits, then turn into enemies and falsehood sounds the bugle (in glee).
3QX9: Without the Word of the Shabad, people wander lost in reincarnation. Through the love of duality, multitudes have been drowned. ||1||
Without the Name, man is knocked about (in transmigration). The love of duality has drowned multitudes of men.
GUJ3: O mind, swim across, by focusing your consciousness on the Shabad.
O my soul! you shall swim across the world ocean by fixing attention on God's Name.
LL66: Those who do not become Gurmukh do not understand the Naam; they die, and continue coming and going in reincarnation. ||1||Pause||
Those who through the Guru, have not understood God's Name are reborn after death and continue coming and going. Pause.
D91J: That body is said to be pure, in which the True Name abides.
That body where in abides the True Name, is said to be pure.
P6DF: One whose body is imbued with the Fear of the True One, and whose tongue savors Truthfulness,
(The Mortal), whose body is tinged with the fear of the True One and whose tongue relishes truthfulness,
4NTZ: is brought to ecstasy by the True Lord's Glance of Grace. That person does not have to go through the fire of the womb again. ||2||
is ecstasised by God's true glance, and faces not sin's heat, again.
JV9Y: From the True Lord came the air, and from the air came water.
From the True Lord, proceeded the air and from air became the water.
WHCE: From water, He created the three worlds; in each and every heart He has infused His Light.
From the water God created the three worlds and in every heart He infused His light.
E32Q: The Immaculate Lord does not become polluted. Attuned to the Shabad, honor is obtained. ||3||
The Immaculate Lord becomes not impure, He, who is imbued with the Name, obtains honour.
6XHD: One whose mind is contented with Truthfulness, is blessed with the Lord's Glance of Grace.
God shows favour in (to) him, whose soul is contented with truthfulness.0

VXDY: The body of the five elements is dyed in the Fear of the True One; the mind is filled with the True Light.
(His body of) five elements, then get dyed in the fear of the True One and the True light shines within his mind.
PUSL: O Nanak, your demerits shall be forgotten; the Guru shall preserve your honor. ||4||15||
Nanak, he forgets (forsakes) sins and the Guru saves his honour.
DEPL: O Nanak, the Boat of Truth will ferry you across; contemplate the Guru.
Nanak the boat of truth ferries man across through the discerning wisdom of the Guru.
7HCH: Some come, and some go; they are totally filled with egotism.
Of the multitudes of men full of pride, some come and some go.
RQAA: Through stubborn-mindedness, the intellect is drowned; one who becomes Gurmukh and truthful is saved. ||1||
Through mind's obstinacy the man of intellect is drowned and through the Guru the true man is saved.
N1CJ: Without the Guru, how can anyone swim across to find peace?
Sans the Guru, how can man swim across and attain peace?
K4BU: As it pleases You, Lord, You save me. There is no other for me at all. ||1||Pause||
As it pleases You so do you save me. I have no other second (to succour me, O Lord). Pause.
R4XM: In front of me, I see the jungle burning; behind me, I see green plants sprouting.
In front I behold the fire of death burning (the mortals) and just behind I see the green plumules.
B5CV: We shall merge into the One from whom we came. The True One is pervading each and every heart.
Whence they are born, thence do they merge. The True Lord is fully filling every heart.
PLV9: He Himself unites us in Union with Himself; the True Mansion of His Presence is close at hand. ||2||
God Himself unites man in His union (and he then), sees the True mansion close-by.
P220: With each and every breath, I dwell upon You; I shall never forget You.
With every breath I meditate in You, (O Lord) and never forget You.
LL6Q: The more the Lord and Master dwells within the mind, the more the Gurmukh drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar.
The more the Master abides within my mind the more the Nectar I quaff through the Guru.
B6B0: Mind and body are Yours; You are my Master. Please rid me of my pride, and let me merge with You. ||3||
My soul and body are Yours and You are my Master. Rid me of ego and merge me in You.
JV31: The One who formed this universe created the creation of the three worlds.
He who created this universe did make the expanse of the three worlds.
4X4C: The Gurmukh knows the Divine Light, while the foolish self-willed manmukh gropes around in the darkness.
Know that the good perceive the Divine light and the perverse fools remain in spiritual darkness.
AF0W: One who sees that Light within each and every heart understands the Essence of the Guru's Teachings. ||4||
He, who perceives God's light within every heart, comes to understand the essence of Guru's teaching.
GRD9: Those who understand are Gurmukh; recognize and applaud them.
Do applaud the pious persons who understand the Lord.
TM9P: They meet and merge with the True One. They become the Radiant Manifestation of the Excellence of the True One.
They meet and merge into the True Lord and in them become manifest the excellences of the True Being.
E0SG: O Nanak, they are contented with the Naam, the Name of the Lord. They offer their bodies and souls to God. ||5||16||
Nanak they feel contented with God's Name and their soul and body are near (at the disposal of) the Lord.
UVWG: Listen, O my mind, my friend, my darling: now is the time to meet the Lord.
Hearken, O my darling, friendly soul! this is the time to meet (the Lord).
0RCT: As long as there is youth and breath, give this body to Him.
As long as there is youth and breath, so long give your body (in Lord's service).
5MTM: Without virtue, it is useless; the body shall crumble into a pile of dust. ||1||
Without virtue it is of no avail, the body shall crumble into a heap of dust.
SLWR: O my mind, earn the profit, before you return home.
O my soul! earn some profit (before) you goest home.
LDFU: The Gurmukh praises the Naam, and the fire of egotism is extinguished. ||1||Pause||
By Guru's grace praise the Name thus the fire of egotism is quenched. Pause.
UV1E: Again and again, we hear and tell stories; we read and write and understand loads of knowledge,
(We) repeatedly hear and coin stories. (As also we) write, read and understand a huge load (of knowledge).
DSD3: but still, desires increase day and night, and the disease of egotism fills us with corruption.
(Nevertheless) day and bight our desires increase and the ailment of vanity produces evil passions.
5XDG: That Carefree Lord cannot be appraised; His Real Value is known only through the Wisdom of the Guru's Teachings. ||2||
That Care-free Lord is unweighable and His real worth is known through Guru's instruction.
0BRG: Even if someone has hundreds of thousands of clever mental tricks, and the love and company of hundreds of thousands of people
If man performs lakhs of deeds of wisdom and bears love and company with lakhs of people,
AVDM: still, without the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, he will not feel satisfied. Without the Name, all suffer in sorrow.
but he is not satiated without sant's society and undergoes suffering and sorrow without the Name.
QQFP: Chanting the Name of the Lord, O my soul, you shall be emancipated; as Gurmukh, you shall come to understand your own self. ||3||
O my soul! by understanding your ownself and meditating on God, through the Guru, you shall be released.
VJ83: I have sold my body and mind to the Guru, and I have given my mind and head as well.
I have sold my body and soul to the Guru and have given my heart and head along with.
YFYP: I was seeking and searching for Him throughout the three worlds; then, as Gurmukh, I sought and found Him.
Seeking, under Guru's guidance I have seen Him, whom I did track and search in the three worlds.
214J: The True Guru has united me in Union, O Nanak, with that God. ||4||17||
Nanak the True Guru has united me in the union of that Lord who is ever with me.
EJPG: I have no anxiety about dying, and no hope of living.
I have no anxiety regarding fear of death nor any hope (craving) for life.
X3SC: You are the Cherisher of all beings; You keep the account of our breaths and morsels of food.
You cherishes all the beings (O Lord!) In account are the breathings and morseles of all.
UZU9: You abide within the Gurmukh. As it pleases You, You decide our allotment. ||1||
Through the Guru You abidest within the heart and as You willest so do You decide.
2M3S: O my soul, chant the Name of the Lord; the mind will be pleased and appeased.
O my Soul! by meditating on the Omnipresent Lord the mind is propitiated.1
PEKZ: The raging fire within is extinguished; the Gurmukh obtains spiritual wisdom. ||1||Pause||
By Guru's instruction Divine knowledge is obtained and the fire raging within is extinguished. Pause.
